_about: Limits that block in scripts/check_page.py. An entry is verified only when the number was read in its primary source on the checked date. These were written from memory, offline, so each is false until someone reads the source.

contrast_text_min.source: WCAG 2.2, success criterion 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), level AA, body text

large_bold_text_px.unit: CSS px (14 pt), weight 700 or more

target_min_px.source: WCAG 2.2, success criterion 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), level AA, with its spacing exception

required_widths.source: 320 from WCAG 2.2 success criterion 1.4.10 Reflow; 768 and 1440 are mstack's own choice of a tablet and a desktop width
